name: fmp_market_losers
description:
Today's largest percentage losers from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/stock-market-losers): symbol, name, price, change and change %.
Returns {losers}: the list of stocks (empty if FMP returns no list).
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of stocks; default 5).
Siblings: fmp_market_gainers, fmp_most_active; sector moves: fmp_sector_performance.
Example: {"limit": 10}
